title: Crash apparently random
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

Godot is crashing at random moments when im working. I cannot find a common reason. I dont know if all the crashes are related or not. Last crash was just as the editor opened. This motivated me to report the issue. 

A week ago i was using v4.4 stable and it was crashing a lot in the same way. 

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) UHD Graphics 615 (AML-KBL) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-10100Y CPU @ 1.30GHz (4 threads) - 7.66 GiB memory
